text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer! That "Champion of Justice" is gonna make a huge splash any minute now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Christmas is right around the corner, right?
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It means Santa Claus is coming to town!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm handing out presents to everyone who was good!
As fellow protectors of peace, I'll always cheer you on~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know! Maybe they'll even
come to your place, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because you worked so hard with me in the Twinkle Series!
Yeah, they'll definitely come!
choice_data_list: Thanks, but hey, I'm an adult after all.
Thank you, but I am an adult, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The very next day—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...All done! A sparkling star and a snowman!
Heheh, I think I drew them pretty well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, it's super buono!
Now all that's left is the message, right!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right on!!
Umm... hmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do, there's too much I want to write!
What should I start with...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
In that case... let's just write down every single thing!
I'm sure you'll find the words you want to share the most~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Thanks a lot!
All right, then first—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they're discussing with Hishi Akebono.
Curious, I called out to them.
choice_data_list: You're awfully engrossed in that. What are you writing?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh?! T-Trainer?!
Umm, you see, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a return gift for a fan letter!
Apparently she got a really
passionate letter from a fan!"
choice_data_list: Is that right! That's great to hear.
Is that right! I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Furthermore, after school that day—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there are so many varieties!
Hmmmm, which one do you think is best?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If you ask me,
it's just like styling an outfit!
The key is figuring out the other person's individuality!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There's definitely something out there that excites them the most!
So, let's think about it together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave finding the decorations to me!
My Class Rep antenna will go *ping* and tell me instantly which ones are Bakushin-worthy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! I see!
Thanks, upperclassmen!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want it to be something really special!
So I wanna check out lots of different shops! Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
!? T-Trainer...!
Um...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Yep, to go clothes shopping with Biko-chan!
You're really curious about winter outfits, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that how it was?
I had assumed—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~!! Y-You two, let's hurry before the shop closes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Biko Pegasus and I were holding a modest little Christmas party together.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
M... Merry Christmaaas!
The day has finally come!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"We even have a Carrotman Christmas cake!
There's nothing missing... Ah—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh shoot~! I forgot to prepare drinks!
Trainer, could you go buy some?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll get the sweets ready,
so I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stepped out into the dimly lit hallway to buy some non-alcoholic champagne.
However, I quickly realized I'd forgotten something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried back to the Trainer's Office,
and just as I was about to open the door...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heave... ho... Mm, just a little more and it'll reach the top of the tree... Whoa-whoa—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH-BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm fine!
I just fell on my butt for a second...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a single message card slipped
from Biko Pegasus's hands.
Written upon it was my own name.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Th-That is...!

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
         Merry Christmas!
I have been watching your hard work from afar.

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text:
"To grant your partner's dream shows what a splendid person you are.
Keep giving it your all alongside young Biko!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　Santa Claus"
choice_data_list: Could this be a letter from Santa...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Tha—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right!! We did it, Trainer!
Santa really came for us!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Santa came by just a minute ago!
He asked me to give this to you in his place, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! After all, they worked
so desperately hard for my sake!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Coming up with special training for me, someone aiming to be a hero—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Like putting together a training routine
so I don't injure my legs!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Santa saw how hard
you've been working, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, Trainer!
...Are you happy for me?
choice_data_list: Yeah! It's the best present ever!
Yeah! It's the best present ever!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! Really?!
Alright... yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! ...I mean,
Santa's saying so too!! Pretty sure, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
S-See!
I was given a present for you too.
Please take it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an excited heart, the colorful wrapping
is carefully unwound. Inside is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Santa knows what's up, too!
He picks out things that me
and Trainer both like, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That communicator is super precious to Captain Onion!
It's proof of their trust—Carrotman will come flying anytime he calls!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So whenever you're in trouble, Trainer,
just call my name!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Anytime, anywhere, I'll come rushing over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an excited heart, the colorful wrapping
is carefully unwound. Inside is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Nice!
Now I can wear it anytime!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The plain one is especially nice, right?!
Flight-senpai said that this way, a person's natural charm really shines—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah...! I-It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I have the exact same one!
choice_data_list: Oh, so that's how it is!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Hehe, we're matching♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to heroes of justice,
a fluttering scarf in the wind is an absolute must!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: As long as we have this—we'll always be fellow heroes!
